creent, Disciplinam conturbent, atque hoc
pacto Seditiones excitent, pacemque publicam violent?
neq;enim Ecclesia turbata, Respublica diu potest

Dogmata ubique spargent & Schismaticorum con-

stratu Christiano interim silente, ac cessante?
Num Ecclesiæ præpositos, eorumque censuras superbe con-
temnent, contra leges Politicas æque ac Ecclesia-
s-ticas, nemine conatibus Ipsorum obstante, con-

non semel à Turbis recessit, partim, ut Inimico-

page.notes: Page is a single text column with no marginal notes. Blurred or doubtful readings: "leguntur" (line 20, possibly "legunter"), "p; opagare" (line 28, unclear), and "innu-" at the end of line 34, which may read differently. The running head "sana" may be "fana" in the scan. Long s is rendered as plain s. The word "ejus-" is hyphenated across lines 18–19 and "merabi-" is split at the page foot, so the text continues onto the next page.
